summary: §6a ran on pvginkel/jenkins-trigger-test with a declarative triggers { githubPush() }. The file declaration puts the trigger on the job but installs no hook, and a push built nothing. A job whose config.xml carries GitHubPushTrigger, at createItem or on a re-post, gets the hook from Jenkins within seconds, and the next push builds. The result and the new-repo recipe (every step Claude's) are in report.md under Appendix A R1, review plan §6a is ticked, and P8/P9/ordering are edited to the recipe. The throwaway job is deleted; close-out A1 (delete the repo) and P5 (the argocd runbook wrongly says the pod token cannot create hooks) are entered.
